import java.awt.Color;
import java.awt.Graphics2D;
import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.util.Arrays;

import javax.imageio.ImageIO;

import net.coobird.thumbnailator.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.builders.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.filters.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.geometry.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.makers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.name.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.resizers.configurations.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.tasks.io.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.*;
import net.coobird.thumbnailator.util.exif.*;

public final class ApiTest {
    private ApiTest() {}

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        try {
            String grid_png = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.png";
    String grid_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Thumbnailator/grid.jpg";
    String exif_jpeg = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/source/src/test/resources/Exif/original.jpg";
    String output_dir = "/Users/clockorangezoe/Documents/phd_projects/code/geoAI/GRAIL_thumbnailator_A1/experiments/external/thumbnailator/.aideal_exec/A1/output";

    // pre-loaded typed inputs (comprehension.execute.preamble)
    BufferedImage sourceImage = new BufferedImage(32, 24, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    Graphics2D graphics = sourceImage.createGraphics();
    graphics.setColor(Color.BLUE);
    graphics.fillRect(0, 0, 32, 24);
    graphics.setColor(Color.YELLOW);
    graphics.fillRect(8, 6, 16, 12);
    graphics.dispose();
    BufferedImage destinationImage = new BufferedImage(16, 12, BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_RGB);
    ByteArrayOutputStream imageBytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
    Path outputPath = Paths.get(output_dir, "thumbnail.png");
    Files.createDirectories(outputPath.getParent());

            // TODO API_TEST_START
            try {
                java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?> targetConstructor = net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter.class.getConstructors()[0];
                for (java.lang.reflect.Constructor<?> cons : net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter.class.getConstructors()) {
                    if (java.util.Arrays.asList(cons.getParameterTypes()).contains(java.awt.Dimension.class)) {
                        targetConstructor = cons;
                        break;
                    }
                }
    
                Object[] args = new Object[targetConstructor.getParameterTypes().length];
                for (int i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
                    Class<?> t = targetConstructor.getParameterTypes()[i];
                    if (t == java.awt.Dimension.class) {
                        args[i] = new java.awt.Dimension(123, 456);
                    } else if (t == double.class) {
                        args[i] = 1.5;
                    } else if (t == boolean.class) {
                        args[i] = true;
                    } else if (t == String.class) {
                        args[i] = "JPEG";
                    } else if (t == float.class) {
                        args[i] = 0.8f;
                    } else if (t == int.class) {
                        args[i] = java.awt.image.BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB;
                    } else if (t == java.util.List.class) {
                        args[i] = java.util.Collections.emptyList();
                    }
                }
    
                net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter param = 
                    (net.coobird.thumbnailator.ThumbnailParameter) targetConstructor.newInstance(args);
    
                java.awt.Dimension size = param.getSize();
                String format = param.getOutputFormat();
    
                assert size == null || size.width == 123 : "Size mismatch in ThumbnailParameter";
                assert format == null || "JPEG".equals(format) : "Format mismatch in ThumbnailParameter";
    
                System.out.println("__CHECK__ ThumbnailParameter " + (size != null ? size.width : "null") + "_" + format);
            } catch (Exception e) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Failed to instantiate and verify ThumbnailParameter", e);
            }
            // TODO API_TEST_END
            System.out.println("__DONE__");
        } catch (Throwable exc) {
            System.err.println("__RUN_ERR__ " + exc.getClass().getSimpleName()
                    + ": " + exc.getMessage());
            exc.printStackTrace(System.err);
            System.exit(1);
        }
    }
}
